name: Validate Task Output
description: General post-task validator. Judges whether a completed task's output impulse is present, well-formed, and free of error/truncation, and emits a validation_result with a boolean passed field. Exists so validator-dispatch's backward discoverByShapesQuery (mode=backward, output_shapes=[validation_result]) finds a validator for common content outputs — real validator templates carry their shapes on TASKS (top-level None), which discover-by-shapes cannot see, so no general validator was discoverable and validator-dispatch ran only its first task. This template advertises validation_result at the TOP LEVEL with broad content input_shapes so the backward query matches parent task outputs like bash_output, file, source_code, gitDiff, llm_completion_result, problem_detection.

tasks.description: Judge whether the parent task's output impulse is a valid, non-empty, well-formed result and emit a validation_result.
